summary: Font and text-layout code was modernized and tuned: a few old feature prefs (font-variations, font-palette, COLRv1 toggles) were removed, font-stretch was renamed to font-width (with the old name kept as an alias), and many text-shaping and hyphenation paths were optimized or hardened. These changes reduce memory and CPU costs during text shaping, make font handling more robust across platforms, and add safer validation to avoid corrupted font data.
